objective: audit the full frozen ASMP-4 completion standard after v0.31 and decide whether more autonomous bounded harness work is evidentially justified

decision_scope.stop: autonomous bounded finite or local fixture expansion
decision_scope.continue_if: a formal global class, abstraction theorem, attributable external adjudication, or dependency-invalidating error is supplied
decision_scope.not_a_resolution: the canonical nonlinear two-port problem remains mathematically unresolved

audit_rules.requirements: extract all five completion requirements from the canonical source
audit_rules.evidence: distinguish conditional registered-lane closure from full-scope proof
audit_rules.unknowns: do not infer a unique formal class from ambiguous canonical wording
audit_rules.necessity: do not make finite exact quotients necessary after the Thue-Morse boundary

stop_argument.finite_lane: region computation and registered cost transfer are closed once a finite public abstraction is supplied
stop_argument.root_gap: the source supplies neither a formal global nonlinear class nor a construction or replacement for its public abstraction
stop_argument.harness_limit: another bounded fixture cannot quantify the missing class or authorize a semantic choice
